title: Gary NDE 6667
content: I was over at a friend's house, sitting on the couch. At first, I felt a very nauseous feeling in my stomach, so I got up off the couch to get something to eat. When I stood up my vision became scrambled, similar to a TV screen. During this time, I felt myself fall back, and then all I saw was blackness, but I was still fully aware and conscious. All I could think about was that I had just died and was freaking out and panicking while praying to God and Jesus to save me. All of a sudden, I started to see light where I was; I thought I was coming to it but I was rising out of my body. I traveled up towards the ceiling and as soon as I started to see the sky, I began traveling faster and faster until I couldn't really make anything out except the light that began to surround me. I think this was because of the speed I was moving at. Then I slowed down and came to a circle that was spinning and inside I could see geometric patterns that were all spinning and moving different ways. I thought it was a gate of some kind and joked to myself thinking, 'what is this, a 'Star gate'? I just went through it. The whole time I was really happy and didn't think whether or not I should be doing it. When I went through that gate, I went through a tunnel or something that brought me to what looked like a star cluster. I moved through outer space to the cluster. I wasn't in control; I was drawn to it and entered some place that looked like a hallway with stars all around me and lights moving through clear tubes. It looked amazing, I wondered what the lights were, and then the thought of them being souls came into my head. I don't know if that was true, but it felt like they were aware of me. That's when I became aware I wasn't wearing anything and my body was emitting light, but still in human form. I also felt like I had been there before and was familiar with the place, which I thought was weird. I came to a wall where these things slid down it that looked like robots, they began melting and transformed, they brought me to a room with a being that was made of light. The room looked like it was made of glass, and then a shower of light came down on me that felt warm and euphoric. The being walked to me and it talked to me through my thoughts and emotions. The being was funny and not threatening. I became extremely sad about leaving my family and friends and it felt like I was about to lose my identity. I tried frantically to leave the place and a female came to me that looked like a girl I had a crush on, but it wasn't her; she brought me back to my body. I felt sad and didn't want to leave her. It was like we had been together before and I loved her. I saw myself rushing to earth, then I started to regain my vision, while being in my body, and my friend was standing over me waving his hand over my eyes that had still been open. He was saying 'hello'. He said I was just sitting there with a spaced out look on my face. The experience felt like a long time, but I don't think it was that long. I told my friend that I just passed out and the weird thing was that he said the same thing had happened to him upstairs in the bathroom, but he said he didn't have the same experience and just blacked out.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Went through a spinning circle 'gate' with geometric patterns, then 'through a tunnel or something' to a star cluster.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Described rising out of body, accelerating 'faster and faster', then being 'drawn' and 'not in control'.

arrival.other_being_detail: Robotic-looking entities that 'melted and transformed' escorted him; later a female who resembled a crush (but 'wasn't her'); a humorous, non-threatening being made of light.

environment.environment_other_detail: Outer space/star cluster; hallway with stars all around; lights moving through clear tubes; room like glass; shower of light.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Sudden nausea and apparent fainting/passing out at a friend's house; experiencer believed he had died.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Spinning geometric 'gate'/'Star gate'; star-cluster/hallway with stars; robotic entities melting/transformation; shower of light; female resembling a crush escorts return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Blackness/fear and prayer, then light and OBE rising, then gate, then tunnel to star cluster/space hallway, then beings and light-being encounter, then wall/return escort and rapid return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Spinning geometric-pattern 'gate' compared to a 'Star gate'; hallway with stars and lights moving through clear tubes; robotic entities that melted/transformed; shower of light in a glass-like room.
